name: Vali
acNote: Mithral plate 18, Repulsion Shield +3, Fighting Style: Defense +1
saveNotes: Advantage on Con saves to keep concentration (Eldritch Mind).

aura.name: Aura of Protection
aura.note: You and allies within 10 ft add +5 to saving throws while you aren't Incapacitated.

blade-ward.name: Blade Ward
blade-ward.text: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

actions.name: Sun Blade
actions.text: Pact weapon (uses Cha). Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + Cha + 2 Radiant (+1d8 vs Undead). Mastery: Sap. Sheds bright light.

actions.name: Vow of Enmity
actions.text: Channel Divinity: for 1 minute you have Advantage on attack rolls against one creature within 30 ft. If it drops to 0 HP, move the vow to another creature (no action).

actions.name: Lay on Hands
actions.text: Touch a creature and restore HP from your pool (60), or spend 5 to end the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Stone's Endurance
actions.text: When you take damage, roll 1d12 + 2 and reduce the damage by that total.

actions.name: Large Form
actions.text: For 10 minutes you are Large, have Advantage on Strength checks, and your speed increases by 10 ft.

actions.name: Parry (Defensive Duelist)
actions.text: When a melee attack hits you while you hold a finesse weapon, add +4 to your AC for that attack and until the start of your next turn.

actions.name: Repulsion Shield
actions.text: When a Large or smaller creature hits you with a melee attack, push it 15 ft straight away.

actions.name: Dark One's Blessing
actions.text: When you (or someone within 10 ft of you) drop an enemy to 0 HP, gain 9 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Divine Smite (free)
actions.text: Once per long rest, cast Divine Smite at level 1 without a slot. Choose “Free smite” in the Sun Blade options.

actions.name: Magical Cunning
actions.text: Spend 1 minute to regain one expended Pact Magic slot.

actions.name: Divine Sense
actions.text: For 10 minutes, sense Celestials, Fiends and Undead within 60 ft, and consecrated or desecrated places.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.text: You and allies within 10 ft add +5 (Cha) to saving throws while you aren't Incapacitated. Applied automatically.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Shield Master: Shield Bash
features.text: Once per turn, after hitting with a melee weapon in the Attack action: Str save DC 14 or pushed 5 ft or Prone. Pick “Shield Bash” in the Sun Blade options.

features.name: Shield Master: Interpose Shield
features.text: When you succeed on a Dex save against half damage, take none instead (while holding a shield).

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn on a weapon hit, roll the damage dice twice and use either. Applied automatically to your first hit each turn.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.text: When you hit with an opportunity attack, the target's speed becomes 0 and you can move half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Pact of the Blade
features.text: Bonded to the Sun Blade: Cha for attack and damage; it can deal Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage.

features.name: Eldritch Mind
features.text: Advantage on Con saves to keep concentration.

features.name: Stone Giant Ancestry
features.text: Stone's Endurance (4/long rest) and Large Form (1/long rest).

features.name: Powerful Build
features.text: Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition; count as Large for carrying.

inventory: Sickle, carpenter's tools, healer's kit, iron pot, shovel, traveler's clothes, torch
flags: Lay on Hands: your sheet's pool is 60. In 2024 it's 5 × Paladin level, which is 40 at Paladin 8. I kept 60; tell me if it should be 40.
Sun Blade: with Pact of the Blade it uses Cha, so +11 to hit and 1d8 + 7 Radiant. The PDF doesn't spell those numbers out, so check them against Eddy's own math.
token: Vali, a stone-giant goliath paladin: towering, bald, grey skin patterned like granite with dark tribal markings, mithral plate armour, a shield engraved with a family crest, a sword-hilt that blazes with a blade of pure golden sunlight, a faint infernal ember glow in his eyes. Stern, protective and relentless.
